title: 3D Printing for Tooling: Optimise Design to Maximise Performance
summary: Looking to up-skill yourself while working from home? Take this opportunity to learn Design Optimisation technology and ensure a seamless 3D design to product manufacturing process with Additive Manufacturing
body:
**On-Demand | 94 minutes**

Looking to up-skill yourself while working from home? Take this opportunity to learn **Design Optimisation** technology and ensure a seamless 3D design to product manufacturing process with **Additive Manufacturing.**

With design optimisation, your 3D design can take advantage on a greater design freedom, meet end-user requirements for functionality, manufacturability and regulations conformance.
